eventLevels.essential: Lifecycle, failures, warnings, taps, long presses and activations, and the camera each time it settles.
eventLevels.camera: Also the start of every camera movement, with its reason, and the start and end of each gesture.
eventLevels.continuous: Also the camera while it moves, at most once per rendered frame or per the requested interval.

cameraReasons.gesture: A person moved the map: a touch, mouse or keyboard gesture, a map control, or the motion that continues after a gesture.
cameraReasons.api: The application moved the camera through the SDK, with or without an animation.
cameraReasons.system: The SDK moved the camera itself, for example after a layout change or during a view mode transition.

resourceKinds.source: A source description, such as TileJSON.
resourceKinds.tile: A vector, raster or elevation tile.
resourceKinds.data: Data the application passed to the map.

errorReasons.protocolVersion: The SDK and the renderer share no protocol version.
errorReasons.runtimeHash: The renderer is not the one the SDK was built with.
errorReasons.webViewVersion: The system WebView is older than the supported minimum.
errorReasons.handshake: The renderer did not complete its handshake in time.
errorReasons.dataTooLarge: Data exceeds the size limit for one item or for all items in flight.
errorReasons.dataIntegrity: Data arrived with a different length or digest than was sent.
errorReasons.dataUnavailable: Data was released before the renderer read it.
errorReasons.graphicsContextLost: The renderer lost its graphics context.
errorReasons.processTerminated: The system ended the renderer process again before it loaded.
errorReasons.contentRestore: Application content could not be restored after the style changed.
errorReasons.scene: The map's 3D scene could not be loaded; the map continues without it.

invalidSource.description: The map source or its configuration is invalid.

missingRuntime.description: The embedded renderer is missing from the application or does not match its receipt.

incompatibleRuntime.description: The SDK and its renderer share no protocol version or identity, or the system WebView is older than the supported minimum.

invalidRequest.description: A call broke its documented contract or limits. Nothing changed.

notReady.description: The map has not finished loading. Retry after it reports that its content is ready.

cancelled.description: The operation stopped before it finished because the renderer was replaced or the work was cancelled.

timeout.description: The renderer did not answer in time.

resourceFailed.description: A map resource or application data could not be loaded or verified.

rendererFailed.description: The renderer stopped or could not complete an operation. Reloading starts a new renderer.

accessDenied.description: The Hosted map is not available to this credential or application.

quotaExceeded.description: The Hosted map reached a usage or spending limit.

rateLimited.description: The Hosted service asked the application to slow down. The session retries on its own.

sessionUnavailable.description: The Hosted service could not be reached. The session retries on its own.

invalidSessionResponse.description: The Hosted service answered outside its contract. The session retries on its own.

missingCredential.description: A Hosted map has no map credential in the application's configuration or its source. A services credential never authorizes a map.

documentation.swift: A Hosted map has no map credential: set `TileflowMapCredential` in the Info.plist, or pass one to ``Tileflow/configure(_:)`` or in the configuration of the map's source. A services credential never authorizes a map.
documentation.kotlin: A Hosted map has no map credential: add the `tileflow_map_credential` string resource, or pass one to `Tileflow.configure` or [TileflowMapSource.hosted]. A services credential never authorizes a map.

invalidConfiguration.description: A Hosted map's configuration cannot be read: a configured value is invalid, or the API origin is not HTTPS.

documentation.swift: A Hosted map's configuration cannot be read: an Info.plist value is invalid, or the API origin is not HTTPS. ``Tileflow/configuration()`` throws the detailed error.
documentation.kotlin: A Hosted map's configuration cannot be read: a resource value is invalid, or the API origin is not HTTPS. `Tileflow.configuration(context)` throws the detailed error.
